full_judgment: 27. From the evidence of prosecution witness we find that Abdul Barek, husband of the deceased and accused appellant Sahera Khatun and father of accused appellant Kawsarun Nessa was taken to the nearby Nagori police camp by the informant and others but no police personnel has been examined in this case. Non-examination of independent witnesses, especially some of the close neighbours calls for a presumption under section 114(g) of the Evidence Act against the prosecution to the effect that had they been examined, they might have deposed against the prosecution case. This view finds support from the case reported in 25 DLR 398.
